verdict.rationale: gstack ships agent-driven skill creation in narrow forms. /skillify codifies a /scrape intent into a reusable script (gstack-docs-9). Domain skills let the agent save per-site notes as skills that are injected in later sessions (gstack-docs-10, gstack-docs-26), and these can be promoted from project to global scope (gstack-docs-11). Dev mode symlinks a checkout so skills are read live (gstack-docs-16). However, nothing shows a general spec, template, or meta-skill that walks an agent through authoring and packaging an arbitrary new SKILL.md end to end. Missing for 10: a documented general skill-authoring spec or template, a meta-skill for creating arbitrary skills, packaging and distribution steps, and hands-on corroboration.
